paginationNotes.sizeDetails: No public size prop. README states page controls are always 24×24 with the small page-number type scale (13px / weight 500). TablePagination owns small/medium for the paired Select only.
paginationNotes.positionDetails: No First/Middle/Last position prop. README documents Figma Position column as documentation only; rendering is deterministic from page, pageCount, siblingCount, and boundaryCount (internal constants, not public props).
paginationNotes.openWork: Arrow hover is explicitly filed as open work — masters draw rest/disabled only for prev/next arrows.
